host_constraints_summary: Host SQ/CQ rings, PRP Lists, and data buffers must be allocated from memory that is reachable by the controller via PCIe (i.e. not in IOMMU-blocked regions unless properly mapped).
All controller-visible addresses must be programmed in the host's IOMMU (Intel VT-d / AMD-Vi / ARM SMMU) if IOMMU is enabled; failure causes PCIe Unsupported Request / TLP error.
BAR0/BAR1 must be located in 64-bit prefetchable memory space (controller may request either 32-bit or 64-bit; 64-bit recommended).
MSI-X table region must be aligned and sized per PCIe MSI-X Capability.
fields.controller_internal_constraints: Controller IP, PCIe PHY, and storage media controller PDK / SDC / floorplan constraints are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope. NVMe Base 1.4 specifies only the protocol-visible register and command/completion semantics.
fields.notes: NVMe Base 1.4 is a protocol/architecture spec; it carries no SDC/UPF/PDK content. Host system designers must ensure (a) PCIe link signal integrity per the underlying PCIe Base Spec, (b) host MMU/IOMMU page tables cover all DMA targets, (c) sufficient bus bandwidth at the negotiated PCIe link width × speed to sustain expected NVMe throughput, (d) MSI-X delivery infrastructure (APIC / GIC), (e) host memory ECC if data-integrity guarantees are required.
